rv.q: It adds up to a bright, crowd-pleasing show, playing to fans of the original without tinkering with the formula that made it such a sleeper hit.
It is an impressively well-made piece of theatre...
This is my first in a long time visit to the Birmingham Repertory Theatre and it won't be my last.
Even with its imperfections, there is plenty here that makes it worth seeing, particularly Sheehan and Siddique's stunning performances.
Withnail and I was a perfectly performed piece of theatre, visually stunning and an excellent tribute to the cult classic, but it might only appeal to those hardened fans of the original.

cn.t: This beloved cult film translates successfully to stage with strong performances and magical design, though the near word-for-word adaptation plays as more of an entertaining tribute than a transformative theatrical experience.
